name: Dim Sum
summary: A round basket of bent bamboo bands, laced with cane where the band's ends overlap, its floor a row of slats on cross-bearers with the table showing between them. Inside, two siu mai (yellow wrappers pleated round pink pork and prawn, open at the top, a dot of orange roe) and two har gow (pleated crescents of translucent wheat-starch skin, the pink prawn showing through).
notes: Shown as it ships in KL Rush, compressed for the web (meshopt geometry and, where it has textures, KTX2). A download copy will be exported from source once the model is cleared.
